mapper.insert: INSERT INTO entities (name, description, category_id, launch_date, discontinuation_date, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{launchDate}, #{discontinuationDate}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT e.* FROM entities e LEFT JOIN entity_tags et ON e.id = et.entity_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON et.tag_id = t.id WHERE e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
